lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਕ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਧ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dak hoi ba(n)dh sudh lahai ||29||
lines.translation: If you turn your thoughts to the Lord, the Lord will take care of you like a relative. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਭਾ ਭੇਦਹਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhabhaa bhedahi bhed milaavaa ||
lines.translation: BHABHA: When doubt is pierced, union is achieved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਭਉ ਭਾਨਿ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਆਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab bhau bhaan bharosau aavaa ||
lines.translation: I have shattered my fear, and now I have come to have faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo baahar so bheetar jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: I thought that He was outside of me, but now I know that He is within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਭੇਦੁ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: bhaiaa bhed bhoopat pahichaaniaa ||30||
lines.translation: When I came to understand this mystery, then I recognized the Lord. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਾ ਮੂਲ ਗਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mamaa mool gahiaa man maanai ||
lines.translation: MAMMA: Clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maramee hoi s man kau jaanai ||
lines.translation: One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਮਿਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat koee man milataa bilamaavai ||
lines.translation: Let no one delay in uniting his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: magan bhaiaa te so sach paavai ||31||
lines.translation: Those who obtain the True Lord are immersed in delight. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mamaa man siu kaaj hai man saadhe sidh hoi ||
lines.translation: MAMMA: The mortal's business is with his own mind; one who disciplines his mind attains perfection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਸਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: man hee man siu kahai kabeeraa man saa miliaa na koi ||32||
lines.translation: Only the mind can deal with the mind; says Kabeer, I have not met anything like the mind. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man sakatee ihu man seeu ||
lines.translation: This mind is Shakti; this mind is Shiva.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man pa(n)ch tat ko jeeu ||
lines.translation: This mind is the life of the five elements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man le jau unaman rahai ||
lines.translation: When this mind is channeled, and guided to enlightenment,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: tau teen lok kee baatai kahai ||33||
lines.translation: it can describe the secrets of the three worlds. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: yayaa jau jaanahi tau duramat han kar bas kaaiaa gaau ||
lines.translation: YAYYA: If you know anything, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subjugate the body-village.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਰਉ ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: ran rootau bhaajai nahee soorau thaarau naau ||34||
lines.translation: When you are engaged in the battle, don't run away; then, you shall be known as a spiritual hero. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਿਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaraa ras niras kar jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: RARRA: I have found tastes to be tasteless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਸ ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi niras s ras pahichaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Becoming tasteless, I have realized that taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih ras chhaade uh ras aavaa ||
lines.translation: Abandoning these tastes, I have found that taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: uh ras peeaa ih ras nahee bhaavaa ||35||
lines.translation: Drinking in that taste, this taste is no longer pleasing. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਐਸੇ ਲਿਵ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lalaa aise liv man laavai ||
lines.translation: LALLA: Embrace such love for the Lord in your mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anat na jaai param sach paavai ||
lines.translation: that you shall not have to go to any other; you shall attain the supreme truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ar jau tahaa prem liv laavai ||
lines.translation: And if you embrace love and affection for Him there,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: tau alah lahai lahi charan samaavai ||36||
lines.translation: then you shall obtain the Lord; obtaining Him, you shall be absorbed in His Feet. ||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਵਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vavaa baar baar bisan samhaar ||
lines.translation: WAWA: Time and time again, dwell upon the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisan sa(n)mhaar na aavai haar ||
lines.translation: Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal bal je bisanatanaa jas gaavai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, who sing the praises of the Saints, the sons of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: visan mile sabh hee sach paavai ||37||
lines.translation: Meeting the Lord, total Truth is obtained. ||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਵਾ ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaavaa vaahee jaaneeai vaa jaane ihu hoi ||
lines.translation: WAWA: Know Him. By knowing Him, this mortal becomes Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: ihu ar ohu jab milai tab milat na jaanai koi ||38||
lines.translation: When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, having been blended, they cannot be known separately. ||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਧਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasaa so neekaa kar sodhahu ||
lines.translation: SASSA: Discipline your mind with sublime perfection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਪਰਚਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੋਧਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat parachaa kee baat nirodhahu ||
lines.translation: Refrain from that talk which attracts the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਪਰਚੈ ਜਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat parachai jau upajai bhaau ||
lines.translation: The heart is attracted, when love wells up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰਾਉ ॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahiaa tah tribhavan raau ||39||
lines.translation: The King of the three worlds is perfectly pervading and permeating there. ||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khakhaa khoj parai jau koee ||
lines.translation: KHAKHA: Anyone who seeks Him, and by seeking Him,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo khojai so bahur na hoee ||
lines.translation: finds Him, shall not be born again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਉ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoj boojh jau karai beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: When someone seeks Him, and comes to understand and contemplate Him,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: tau bhavajal tarat na laavai baaraa ||40||
lines.translation: then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਸਹ ਸੇਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasaa so sah sej savaarai ||
lines.translation: SASSA: The bed of the soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਹੀ ਸੰਦੇਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee sahee sa(n)deh nivaarai ||
lines.translation: her skepticism is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: alap sukh chhaad param sukh paavaa ||
lines.translation: Renouncing the shallow pleasures of the world, she obtains the supreme delight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਓੁਹੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: tab ih tree ouhu ka(n)t kahaavaa ||41||
lines.translation: Then, she is the soul-bride; He is called her Husband Lord. ||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haahaa hot hoi nahee jaanaa ||
lines.translation: HAHA: He exists, but He is not known to exist.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab hee hoi tabahi man maanaa ||
lines.translation: When He is known to exist, then the mind is pleased and appeased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai tau sahee lakhai jau koee ||
lines.translation: Of course the Lord exists, if one could only understand Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: tab ohee uhu ehu na hoee ||42||
lines.translation: Then, He alone exists, and not this mortal being. ||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: li(n)u li(n)u karat phirai sabh log ||
lines.translation: Everyone goes around saying, I'll take this, and I'll take that.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kaaran biaapai bahu sog ||
lines.translation: Because of that, they suffer in terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakhimee bar siu jau liu laavai ||
lines.translation: When someone comes to love the Lord of Lakhshmi,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: sog mitai sabh hee sukh paavai ||43||
lines.translation: his sorrow departs, and he obtains total peace. ||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਗਏ ਕੇਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khakhaa khirat khapat gae kete ||
lines.translation: KHAKHA: Many have wasted their lives, and then perished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਨਹ ਚੇਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khirat khapat ajahoo(n) nah chete ||
lines.translation: Wasting away, they do not remember the Lord, even now.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab jag jaan jau manaa rahai ||
lines.translation: But if someone, even now, comes to know the transitory nature of the world and restrain his mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: jah kaa bichhuraa tah thir lahai ||44||
lines.translation: he shall find his permanent home, from which he was separated. ||44||
